body:
Resolved the web-vs-PARENA-UI architecture question (CP-SIP-CONTINUE): local bundled HTML/CSS/JS in android/app/src/main/assets/, rendered via android.webkit.WebView (file:///android_asset/index.html) -- not PARENA's own UI surface, which has no proven Android target (same SDL2/NDK gap already blocking the native SIP core). Same real WebView-in-native-Activity pattern MJOLNIR already uses. Three real, working screens (CP-SIP-124455): Dial (12-key keypad, number display, call/backspace, demo-labeled simulate-incoming-call), Incoming Call (caller placeholder, accept/decline), Config (SIP account fields, localStorage on-device, password excluded). JetBrains Mono (CP-SIP-CONTINUE-123) bundled locally as real .woff2 + SIL OFL license text. No real SIP signaling wired in yet -- named, honest hand-off points only. Real Claude Design canvas (CP-SIP-24332) published for visual review: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/935808bf-007d-4ab2-a03a-1b2e3cee1241. Commit c459907.

⚓ ☃
title: CarePyre SIP Phone Phase 6: real WebView UI (dial/incoming call/config) + design canvas
